headline: PHI @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 5.69 at WSN 4.22, with a projected total of 9.91. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +1.01 runs while WSN moved -0.14, changing the projected margin by +1.15 runs. The projected total climbed +0.88, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cristopher Sánchez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nasim Nuñez, CJ Abrams, Bryson Stott, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
